name: Bauhaus Geometric
tagline: Circle, square, triangle. Three colors, one grid.
description: A light-first system built from the three basic shapes and the three primaries. Pages sit on a visible grid of thick ink rules; circles, squares, and triangles are composed as the illustration. Red is the only action color, blue carries data and information, yellow is for shapes only. Corners are square everywhere except the circle.

fonts.role: display headlines and numerals, uppercase, tight tracking

palette.role: the only action color: primary buttons, selected state, errors
information and data: charts, info badges, links in body copy
shapes and highlights only; never text, never on its own as a signal in light mode
finish swatch only: black stained ash; always drawn with an edge border

do: Build every page on a visible grid of 3px ink rules
Use the circle, the square, and the triangle as the illustration, filled with the three primaries
Set headlines in League Spartan uppercase with tight tracking, numbering sections 01, 02, 03
Keep red for actions and selection, blue for information, yellow for shapes
Keep corners square; only true circles are round
dont: Do not round corners on cards, buttons, or fields
Do not use shadows, gradients, or textures
Do not set text in yellow or put body text on a colored shape
Do not use more than one red button on a screen
Do not draw pictorial icons where a plain shape or an arrow will do

components.name: Button
components.notes: Square corners, 3px ink border. Primary is red with an ink border; secondary is surface with an ink border that inverts on hover; ghost is an uppercase text link with an arrow. Pressed shifts 2px down and right.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Surface field with a 2px ink border, uppercase label above, unit suffix for dimensions in cm. Focus thickens to a 3px blue outline; error turns the border and message red.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Same frame as the input with a triangle chevron; finishes and wood types.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Square checkbox that fills red with a check; radio is a circle that fills blue. Switch is a rectangular track with a square knob.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Square-cornered tags led by a tiny shape: circle for in stock, triangle for low stock, square for made to order.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Product card: a composition of shapes as the image, product name in uppercase, dimensions, price, and a square add button.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Wordmark built from a circle, a square, and a triangle; uppercase links; a cart count in a red square. Mobile menu is a details disclosure with full-width rows.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Square panel with a 3px ink border and a blue title bar, delivery form, two actions.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Order lines on a ruled grid: module, finish, size, quantity, price, with a total row in bold.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Grid tiles split by 3px rules: a large shape composition, a blue bar chart of delivery weeks, a stat, a finish swatch row, and a quote.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: An empty square frame with a lone circle, "Your shelf is empty", one line, one red action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Ink bar with a yellow square marker and an undo action.
